p.i: Aferoth. Iratus autem est Dominus contra Israel, & vendidit eos in manus Chusan Riseathaym regis Mesopotamiae, seruiqe erunt; filii Israel Chusan Riseathaym octo annis. Et cùm clamassent filii Israel ad Dominũ, suscitauit Dominus saluatorem filiis Israel, atque liberauit eos, nepe Othniel filium Kenaz fratris Caleb, qui illo minor erat. Factusq; est super eum spiritus Domini, & iudicauit Israelem: & egressus in praelium tradidit Dominus in manu eius Chusan Riseathaym regem Syriae, praevaluitq; manus eius contra Chusan Riseathaym. Et quieuit terra quadraginta annis, mortuusq; est Othniel filius Kenaz.

main_text.p: 1 Historia haec probat veritatem verbo-rum Dei,id est, omnium praeceptorum, minarum & promissionum eius. Sicuti enim praedixit Deut. 7. ita factum est, vt hic legimus. Nam vt multa bona nascuntur ex coniugio recte, & in nomine ac timore Dei initio: sic plurima mala ex coniugio prauo & impio .i. contra mandatum Dei contracto, veluti sunt, seruitus deorum alienorum, in quibus recensentur non solum Baalim & Aseroth, sed etiam Mammona, venter, &c. item obliuio veri Dei: ira Dei, bellu, seruitus, &c. Exod.23. Iosu.23.

page.notes: Top-left of the first line shows a stray mark before "Aferoth"; it is uncertain and may be residue of the previous line, so the initial letter of "Aferoth" should be checked. The page number "141" is printed at the top right; the final digit is hard to confirm (it may be "14i"). Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, and the f-shaped long s in words such as "ferui", "Iofu" and "feruitus" has been read as s (seruī, Iosu, seruitus). Tildes and macrons over vowels (Dominũ, eruntq;, factusq;) are kept as printed. A few dash-like scan marks lie along the left edge and are not text. A tiny mark at the bottom left (around "ı") is too unclear to call a signature, so it is omitted. The Greek or Hebrew reading of "Riseathaym" has not been checked against any other source.
